crossRefs.note: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.
Yahweh said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God…
You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are…
You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are…
It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts…
It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship…
There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

translations.web: “ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
translations.bsb: “This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘The gate of the inner court that faces east must be kept shut during the six days of work, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon it shall be opened.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
translations.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
